verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents a native four-eyes Feature Change Request workflow (create, approve, publish) explicitly analogous to GitHub PRs, plus Release Pipelines that can auto-generate change requests when promoting flags to production, and RBAC to restrict who can modify production environments. This directly satisfies the governance requirement for approvals before production flag changes go live. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the approval gating in practice (only first-party docs cited).
